title: Game Tracker Live: what's new (Oct 18 - Oct 24)

features.title: Game notifications are live
features.text: tap the bell on any game (on its card, or its row in the game list) and you'll get a notification for every score, red-zone trip, two-minute warning, quarter, halftime and the final, even with the tab closed (on a computer, as long as Chrome is running). The first tap asks your browser for permission; that's it. Works in Chrome on a computer or Android. On iPhone, add Game Tracker Live to your Home Screen first: tap a bell in Safari and it walks you through it, step by step. [b]Heads up:[/b] notifications can beat your TV. They've been arriving before the play shows on YouTube TV, so you may want to skip the bell on the game you're watching.

features.title: Notifications that read at a glance
features.text: what happened up top in bold ("TD Cardinals"), then the game, then the new score, with team names instead of abbreviations. Made extra points are skipped; a missed PAT, a 2-point conversion or a failed 2-point try gets its own notification. On a computer, a score shows the scoring team's logo.

features.title: Stats
features.text: a new gear menu switch. Each live game shows its two top offensive players, one per team, and a button that opens both teams' passing, rushing and receiving leaders plus team totals (yards, turnovers, 3rd down, possession). Finished games get a Stats link next to Recap. I was hesitant to add this, since I don't want the app to get bloated, but it's off unless you turn it on, so hopefully it stays out of your way. A buddy of mine asked for it specifically, so I figured others might want it too.

features.title: New Home Screen icon
features.text: the Game Tracker Live wordmark on a football field.

fixes: Hovering a card no longer makes its buttons flicker when the scores refresh.
No more accidental zooming on phones.
The LIVE badge's text sits dead center.
